predictions.articleTitle: Ecuador vs Bolivia Tactical Breakdown & Probabilistic Modeling: Possession Control vs Scoring Drought
predictions.coreRecommendation: Ecuador is projected to defeat Bolivia by a 2:0 or 1:0 margin in Guayaquil, combining home territorial control with a clean sheet against scoreless visitors.
possibilityAssessment: Primary Thesis: Home Win via sustained Ecuadorian possession and defensive solidity despite friendly rotation (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)
Secondary Angle: Under 2.5 Goals driven by Ecuador's 1.20 goal average, high big-chance waste, and Bolivia's five-match scoring drought (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Contingency Angle: Narrow 1:0 attrition grind if rotated Ecuadorian forwards take time to unlock Bolivia's 4-3-3 low block (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Ecuador's possession dominance tests Bolivia's five-match scoreless drought in Guayaquil.

spf.comment: Backed by a +250 Elo edge, strong home defense, and Bolivia's five consecutive scoreless defeats, Ecuador projects to secure a 2:0 or 1:0 win.

over_under.comment: A 2.25 combined lambda, Ecuador's 90.0% big-chance waste rate, friendly rotation, and Bolivia's 0.00 decayed scoring form anchor Under 2.5.

btts.comment: Bolivia has failed to score in five straight friendlies and six of eight sample matches, while Ecuador kept clean sheets in two of three home outings.

score.comment: Ecuador's home control and Bolivia's 0:2 defeats to Peru and Paraguay point to 2:0, with 1:0 covering rotation-induced finishing friction.

goals.comment: The Poisson distribution peaks at two goals (26.7%) and one goal (23.7%), matching a one-sided low-to-moderate scoring home win.

bqc.comment: Ecuador led at halftime in all three home sample wins while Bolivia trailed at the break in 75% of matches, with Draw-Win covering slow rotation starts.
